mapper.sql: FROM education_achievements a JOIN employment_rate_improvement_achievement_details d ON d.achievement_id = a.achievement_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id

a.achievement_id, a.management_no, a.teacher_user_id, COALESCE((SELECT k.name FROM korus_personnel_snapshots k WHERE k.employee_no = u.employee_no ORDER BY k.snapshot_year DESC LIMIT 1), u.login_id) AS teacher_name, a.organization_code, a.evaluation_year, a.management_item_code, a.achievement_date, d.special_lecture_start_date, d.special_lecture_end_date, d.mock_exam_question_period, a.achievement_status, a.attachment_ref, a.created_at, a.created_by, a.updated_at, a.updated_by
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE a.achievement_id = #{id} AND a.achievement_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_IMPROVEMENT' AND a.deleted_yn = 'N' FOR UPDATE OF a

SELECT m.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.mapping_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND CURRENT_DATE >= m.effective_start_date AND (m.effective_end_date IS NULL OR CURRENT_DATE <= m.effective_end_date) ORDER BY m.effective_start_date DESC, m.mapping_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT m.management_item_code FROM evaluation_management_items m JOIN evaluation_elements e ON e.element_id = m.element_id JOIN evaluation_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id JOIN evaluation_areas a ON a.area_id = i.area_id WHERE m.active_yn = 'Y' AND e.active_yn = 'Y' AND i.active_yn = 'Y' AND a.active_yn = 'Y' AND a.area_code = 'EDUCATION' ORDER BY m.management_item_code

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM function_permissions f WHERE f.screen_id = 'SCR-EMPLOYMENT-RATE-IMPROVEMENT-ACHIEVEMENT' AND f.function_type = #{function} AND f.permission_allowed = 'ALLOW' AND f.role_code IN #{role}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employment_rate_improvement_achievement_details ( achievement_id, special_lecture_start_date, special_lecture_end_date, mock_exam_question_period ) VALUES (#{id}, #{body.specialLectureStartDate}, #{body.specialLectureEndDate}, #{body.mockExamQuestionPeriod})
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = #{body.managementItemCode}, achievement_date = #{body.achievementDate}, attachment_ref = #{body.attachmentRef}, achievement_status = #{status}, updated_by = #{userId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE achievement_id = #{id} AND achievement_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_IMPROVEMENT' AND deleted_yn = 'N'
